user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Late-Night Ramen Shop. A tiny ramen counter restaurant at night: a wooden bar with stools, steaming ramen bowls with chopsticks, hanging paper lanterns, a curtained noren doorway, a wall of handwritten menu boards, stacked sake bottles, and a busy kitchen nook with pots and a glowing stove. Steam curls from bowls and pots while warm lantern light fills the room. Style: cozy anime-inspired. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
